1. [... h]undred and eighty-eight
  2. [...]ny Metropolis
  3. [... "I, Sahl b. David, d]esire, intentionally and of
  4. [my free will ... to take ... to be] my wife. And I will sustain 
  5. [her ... in the manner of Jewish men, who ...] their [wives] faithfully. And I will give
  6. [you your mohar and ketubba ...as Moses/the sages instructed to give to the virgins, the daughters of Is]rae[l. And] I will cleanse you of any vow"
  7. [...] And this Qurrat al-ʿAyn undert[ook]
  8. [...] to this [Sa]hl, the groom, b. David
  9. [in the manner of Jewish wives, who ...] honor and serve their husbands in purity
  10. [... He betrothed her] with twenty-eight dinars. Twenty
  11. [...] of the land of Israel, who give
  12. [... If this Sahl,] the [groom,] b. David hates this Qurrat al-ʿAyn
  13. [... he shall pay her] all that is written in this marriage contract.
  14. And if this Qurrat al-ʿAyn ... hates this Sahl,] the young man, the groom, b. David, a gratuitous hatred,
  15. [...] with her/him according to the law and the Torah.
  16. ["... And I will not wrong you concerning a]ll of this." And they also stipulated between themselves
  17. [... "If you, Qurrat al-ʿAyn daughter of Sim]ḥa go to your eternal home
  18. [before me, ... t]hey shall inherit your ketubba money
  19. [...If I, Sahl b. Davi]d, go to my eternal home before
  20. [you, female children ... married] to Jewish men. And you 
  21. [shall dwell ... until] my heirs [choos]e to pay you all
  22. [that is written in your marriage contract ... And all that] I have [acquired] or that I shall acquire, whether real estate
  23. [or movables ... will be surety for] your ketu[bba mon]ey." And this marriage contract
  24. [is valid ... wherever it will be presented and read, whether according to the statutes of our esteemed and re]vered [sages] or according to the law (of the gentiles).
  25. [... They instructed the scribe to write, the witnesses to] testify, and the signatories to sign.
  26. ...I...
